sun-sun.harmony: Your core selves resonate — what matters to you matters to them. Easier to read each other's moves without explaining.
sun-sun.magnetic: A strong pull — you see opposite sides of the world, and that makes you curious. A polarity pair that can complete or wear thin, depending on the conscious work.
sun-sun.tension: How you carry yourselves in the world pulls opposite ways. There's a lot to learn from the side that isn't natural to either of you — but it takes routine compromise to stop wearing each other out.
sun-sun.neutral: Your core selves don't boost or drag each other. Comfortable running parallel, without high intensity or major friction.

moon-moon.harmony: Your ways of feeling and self-soothing when down are similar. You calm each other without saying it — same emotional language.
moon-moon.magnetic: Your emotional needs complement each other: one wants closeness, the other wants room. Works when you're honest about what you need — without that, easy to misread.
moon-moon.tension: Your emotion-regulation styles differ sharply. What soothes one of you can grate on the other. Big lesson: don't assume your partner needs the same comfort you do.
moon-moon.neutral: Your emotional worlds are separate but not in conflict. You don't automatically understand each other, but you don't bother each other either — explicit communication is the key.

rising-rising.harmony: How you present in the world looks similar — what someone expects from seeing one of you, they get from the other. Easy to be a team that faces the world the same way.
rising-rising.magnetic: Your outer presentation is opposite — they're drawn precisely because you radiate what they don't express. Real first-glance chemistry.
rising-rising.tension: Your first impressions can misread each other. Takes longer to really see the real version — don't rush conclusions from the first touch.
rising-rising.neutral: How you present lives on its own track. Not a natural fit, not a clash — what matters is substance, not packaging.

sun-moon.harmony: How you show up in the outer world matches what they need emotionally. They feel safe around you without much explanation.
sun-moon.magnetic: What you radiate is the opposite of what's usually around them — curious, sometimes confused. A strong pull that needs extra awareness.
sun-moon.tension: How you exist in the world can disturb how they regulate emotion. Nobody's fault — just two frequencies that don't auto-tune.
sun-moon.neutral: Your way of being and their emotional needs run parallel — no boost or drag. Emotional connection takes conscious effort.

sun-rising.harmony: Who you really are matches what they expect from a first impression. Consistent — what they see early matches what they get inside.
sun-rising.magnetic: Your core self is the opposite of what they usually look for at the surface. Curiosity rises precisely because of the mismatch.
sun-rising.tension: The outer version they expect from a partner drifts from your inner version. Misalignment risk — early honesty about who you really are helps a lot.
sun-rising.neutral: Your real self and their surface expectations neither contradict nor naturally match. The relationship grows more through substance than initial vibe.
